headline: Exchanges Take In $2,077.6 Million as Bitcoin Falls 1.69 Percent to 77k
narrative: Crypto exchanges took in 2,077.6 million dollars over 24 hours, equal to 0.8392 percent of reserves, a distribution print as coins arrived on venues. Bitcoin fell 1.69 percent and changed hands near 77k, so that inventory met a lower spot price. Exchange reserves rose 187,047.28 bitcoin over seven days, the same intake in the spot pipe.
author: jordan
